title: Lime and herb cod
summary: Lime and herb cod is a thai dinner built around cod fillets and lime juice, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat cod fillets dry and season it. Prep lime juice and fresh coriander for Lime and herb cod so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook cod fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook lime juice and fresh coriander in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Lime and herb cod before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice cod fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.

image.alt: Lime and herb cod served for dinner
